title: owners.config.yaml
description: Repository-level CODEOWNERS configuration: the ordered sections of the generated file, their static entries, and the settings governing fragment discovery.

sections.description: Ordered. Render order equals declaration order, and CODEOWNERS matching is last-match-wins, so broader matches belong earlier.

allowed-owner-yaml-paths.description: Repo-root-relative globs naming every location a fragment may occupy. A fragment found anywhere else is an error, so ownership cannot be hidden in an unexpected place.

default-section.description: Section that receives fragment entries that name no section of their own.

output.description: Rendered file, relative to the repository root.

minimum-path-owners.description: Owners required on a fragment path entry. Teams count as the individuals they expand to.

minimum-label-owners.description: Service owners required on a label-owners block, evaluated after fragments are unioned. Teams count as the individuals they expand to.

name.description: Unique. Fragments and entries route to a section by this name.

defined-in-files.description: Accepts entries contributed by owners.yaml fragments. A section may also declare static entries; the two sets are ordered together with no positional privilege.

sort.description: Sort this section's entries. When false they render in authored order.

exclude-from-check-package.description: Hides this section from check-package path resolution. Set it on repo-wide guardrails, which own every package's path but say nothing about whether a package declared owners of its own. The entries still render.

paths.description: Static path entries, rendered exactly as written and never validated against the membership cache.

label-owners.description: Static label-owner blocks, rendered exactly as written.

path.description: Repo-absolute CODEOWNERS path expression, rendered verbatim.
